links.comparator_used: Conventional zero-shot chain-of-thought prompt performing the whole task in one step
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy (primary diagnosis and top three diagnoses) on 322 Diagnosis Please quiz cases
links.effect: Primary diagnosis accuracy 60.6% for two-step vs 56.5% for baseline (p=0.042); top three accuracy 70.5% vs 66.5% (p=0.005). Summary-only: 56.3% primary, 65.5% top three, with no significant difference from baseline.
links.quote: Primary diagnosis accuracy was 60.6% for the two-step approach, compared to 56.5% for baseline (p=0.042) and 56.3% for summary-only (p=0.035).
